before: Shorts source discovery admitted nearby SRT/VTT and structured dictionary JSON timing, but did not interpret a top-level legacy timing array.
The engine stopped at SHORT_TRANSCRIPT_REQUIRED:LOCAL_TRANSCRIPT_OR_TIMING_REQUIRED when EP001 had trusted timing evidence but no manually selected transcript.
There was no generic authority resolver, final-audio binding, canonical timed-transcript cache, or desktop resume invalidation for this legacy path.
root_cause.ep001_trigger: tts-absolute-timeline-repair-v1.json is a 43-item absolute TTS/timeline-repair JSON array with canonical_text_ar, start_seconds, end_seconds, and a filter proof, rather than a nested segments object.

source_discovery.normal_path: nearby metadata/transcript candidate discovery and deterministic hash matching
source_discovery.legacy_path: discover_episode_sources -> resolve_legacy_timing when normal timing is absent
source_discovery.safe_result: READY with ready_without_manual_file=true when the resolver returns a hash-bound resolution

engine_ingestion.normal_path: explicit transcript or structured metadata timing
engine_ingestion.legacy_path: ingest_episode -> resolve_legacy_timing -> TranscriptSegment conversion preserving source text

desktop_resume.binding: source_metadata_hashes are persisted and compared on restore

desktop_surface.user_state: transcript status is completed and Analyze is enabled only after admission PASS
desktop_surface.internal_details: resolver internals remain outside the primary UX message

ambiguity_risks.historical_script_versions: accepted only when an explicit raw or canonical script hash selects one; otherwise no silent selection

before: video hash was not part of a canonical timing artifact
timing source and final audio were not one resolver decision
cache key and evidence hashes were absent
after: video, final audio, timing, script, evidence records, canonical transcript, and cache key are hash-bound
unrelated output hashes in the same record are excluded from path binding

before: reconstruction was not persisted as a task-owned canonical transcript
desktop resume did not carry legacy evidence hashes
after: cache key includes episode_id, source_video_sha256, source_audio_sha256, timing_source_sha256, script_source_sha256, evidence hashes, and resolver_version

ux_impact.before: EP001 displayed missing timed transcript and required manual selection
ux_impact.after: Desktop Source Discovery returns READY; ready_without_manual_file=true; Source Admission is PASS; Analyze is startable
ux_impact.manual_fallback: still available for explicit user-selected SRT/VTT/JSON or insufficient/ambiguous evidence

historical_evidence_policy: all pre-existing untracked evidence was preserved and not staged
